payload.purpose_context: Open-packs still runs a Python copy of the charter's cross-pack rules because pack-check misses some faults that registration refuses and both accept some faults the operator now rules must be refused. This mission renames pack-check to pack-doctor (validate and remediate), makes registration and pack-doctor refuse unheld or undeclared preset ids and stale manifest hashes, adds the closure walk under --full, and adds a structured report and a manifest and canonical-form remediation, so open-packs can retire its Python rules.
payload.purpose_tldr: One answer on every surface: pack-doctor and registration refuse the same pack faults, and pack-doctor can repair manifests.

payload.question: #629/#632.1: do registration and pack-check refuse an unheld must_have and an undeclared preset id?

payload.final_answer: R-a Both refuse: registration and pack-check refuse a must_have no pack of the declaring pack's depends_on closure holds, and an activated_* id no closure pack declares as that kind; supersedes A10/C31 and the 2026-11-06 ruling for writes; reads keep reporting requiredNotHeld

payload.question: #630: what is the one answer for a stale manifest hash?

payload.final_answer: R-b Refuse everywhere: manifest_stale at pack-manifest.yaml in the manifest gate beside manifest_membership; validate, pack-doctor and whole-pack registration refuse; round trip drops its duplicate; amends ADR-0042
R-c the same pack-check jar, renamed pack-doctor, in accordance with the doctor surfaces of the as-is system

R-d Close reverse gap: compose reference, enhancement-target and specialization-cycle checks per pack within its depends_on closure, same codes; cross-level re-declaration, unheld bare endpoints and slots outside an activation are not the charter's to judge
R-e pack-doctor validate and pack-doctor remediate; validate has a full-closure option and an option to write findings to a structured yaml/xml report file

payload.question: Rename in this PR or its own?

payload.final_answer: R-g Not charter's; close: #52.3 obsolete; #535 recorded as core's activation-token concern, closed not_planned

payload.question: What does the full-closure option switch?

payload.final_answer: R-h --full adds the closure walk; default PACK + CLOSURE; --round-trip stays separate
R-j Manifest + canonical form: derive and stamp pack-manifest.yaml and rewrite modelled files in the round trip's canonical form (ADR-0036)
R-k depends_on + parent_pack: the declaring pack's own composition closure, not dependents

payload.question: What counts as present for a preset item?

payload.final_answer: R-l Declared vs held: activated item declared as its kind (graph node or artifact file) in the closure; must_have held as an artifact file; fixtures fixed

payload.question: Wire codes for preset item refusals?

payload.final_answer: R-m New preset codes: preset_item_undeclared and preset_item_not_held in CharterRefusalCode
Confirmed in general; run an alignment and design squad over ADR-0082 / PR #634 (done: architect, planner, researcher, all aligned-with-changes)

payload.question: XML report shape: JUnit XML or a schema of our own mirroring the YAML report?

payload.final_answer: R-n own schema at first, see if a XUnit compatible version is possible later on

payload.question: Engineering alignment: WP01 #614, WP02 rename, WP03 preset rule, WP04 manifest_stale, WP05 --full domain phase, WP06 report, WP07 remediate, WP08 ADR/contract/docs/drafts
